sample_label: Integrated runtime, regression and scope observation
independence: Non-independent verification in the implementation context; compiler, tests, Flyway, browser and repository tools provide separate sensors.

measurements.raw_evidence: Archive eligibility, conflict and scope tests passed; a real read message archived without changing unread count.
Archived view showed archive metadata and restore returned the item as read.

measurements.sensor: Confirmation UI and bulk service test
measurements.raw_evidence: Confirmation is mandatory and backend conditions preserve unread rows while returning changed count.
limitation: The live bulk mutation was cancelled to preserve current user history.

measurements.sensor: Service query tests, browser count checks and responsive probes
measurements.raw_evidence: View totals remain separated, unread remained 2 through archive/restore, and all required viewports had no horizontal overflow.

measurements.sensor: Service scope tests, contract review and migration observation
measurements.raw_evidence: Authentication owns recipient identity, no records are deleted, legacy unreadOnly is retained and V79 applied successfully.
limitation: Cross-user browser isolation was not sampled with a second signed-in account.

disturbances: Full Maven regression was externally blocked by an invalid Docker environment after all notification-owning modules passed.
Governance and scope validators reported known repository history and requested branch-name deviations outside product behavior.
coverage_gaps: Docker-backed architecture regression remains pending a healthy Docker daemon.
